value.positive_en: When should someone see a doctor before traveling out of the country for vaccines or medicines to prevent specific illnesses?
value.positive_zh: 出国旅行前，如果可能需要疫苗或预防特定疾病的药物，应在什么时候看医生？
value.evidence: If you are traveling out of the country, you might also need vaccinations or medicines to prevent specific illnesses. Which ones you need will depend on what part of the world you're visiting, the time of year, your age, overall health status, and previous vaccinations. See your doctor 4 to 6 weeks before your trip. Most vaccines take time to become effective.
value.expected_answer: See your doctor 4 to 6 weeks before your trip.
value.missing_en: What percentage of travelers develop diarrhea after drinking unsafe water in developing countries?
value.missing_reason: The summary says water in developing countries can contain organisms that cause stomach upset and diarrhea, but it does not provide any percentage of travelers affected.
